title: Current Trends in Electrical and Computer Engineering
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in MATH140.
Corequisite: Currently enrolled in (or earned a minimum of C- in) ENEE140 or CMSC131; or a score of 5 on the Computer Science A AP exam; or satisfactory performance on the department's placement exam.
Restriction: Junior standing or higher; and must be in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering; or permission of instructor.
Credit only granted for: ENEE101 or ENEE301.
